== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The original retained slip has no deployment limit. The 25 August 2003 Rules Supplement explicitly adds one per Death Star and the February 2004 issue repeats it. The 2006 sheet replaces that limit with a set-symbol restriction that applies even while the card is suspended. Each of these issuer texts specifies a loss of 2 Force.
